tldr: Uranus in the 7th house: freedom becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With Uranus in the 7th house, this part of you awakens through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. Uranus describes freedom, disruption, originality, change, and the need to break from stale patterns. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. Uranus can become honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point.
gift: honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
